access.title: Administration access
access.description: Your platform role applies to the organization shown below.
access.scope_notice: Private workspace content remains subject to workspace permissions.

state.denied_description: Your account does not have an active platform role. Contact a platform administrator if you need access.
state.unsupported_title: Administration is unavailable on this server
state.unsupported_description: This server does not provide a supported platform administration session.
state.unavailable_description: Your session is still active. Try again when the server is available.

executions.title: Tasks and executions
executions.description: Inspect execution metadata across the organization. Private content keeps its original access rules.
executions.unavailable_hint: Check the filters or connection, then try again.
executions.empty: No executions in this time range
executions.empty_hint: Adjust the creation-time range or clear filters.
executions.content_restricted: Your platform role grants metadata access. Original content requires its existing workspace or conversation permissions.
executions.usage_missing: No usage has been reported for this execution.
executions.live_notice: Creation-time pagination is fixed to this snapshot. Execution status and reported usage may continue to change.
executions.business_description: Business tasks remain distinct from their individual execution attempts.
executions.issue_empty: No business tasks in this time range
executions.copy_failed: Could not copy. Select and copy the execution ID below.

users.title: Accounts
users.description: Review account access and manage credentials without changing workspace membership.
users.name: Name
users.noApproval: Registration does not require approval or automatically join a workspace.
users.noMemberships: This account has no workspace memberships in this organization.
users.actionNotice: This revokes the target account's existing sessions and credentials. Workspace memberships and history are preserved.
users.roleNotice: Granting or promoting a platform role requires the target account to sign in again.
users.processNotice: Revoked access does not confirm that a process on an offline device has stopped.
users.recoveryNotice: Deliver the temporary password through your approved company channel. The account must change it at the next sign-in. Nothing is sent automatically.
users.uncertain: The response was lost. Keep this operation key and check its status before retrying.
users.notRecorded: No operation is recorded yet. Retry with the same key and unchanged details.
users.conflict: The account changed or the action is no longer allowed. Refresh the account before trying again.
users.passwordFailed: Your password could not be verified. Enter it again.
users.targetUnavailable: The account is still blocked by deployment policy. Contact your deployment operator.
users.failed: The change could not be completed. Check the details and try again.
users.noActions: No account changes are available with your current permissions.
users.partial: These results are incomplete. Continue to the next page to find more matching accounts.
users.dateRangeHint: Dates use UTC and include the final day. Today includes accounts created so far.
users.tempPasswordHint: Use 6–128 characters. The account must choose a new password at its next sign-in.
users.tempPasswordMismatch: The temporary passwords do not match. Enter the same password in both fields.
users.adminPasswordHint: Enter your own password to authorize this reset.
users.resetNotice: This signs the target account out of Web and desktop, revokes its personal access, task and daemon tokens, cancels tasks on its runtimes, and disconnects those runtimes. Workspace memberships, installation records and history are preserved.
users.resetDisabledNotice: This account remains disabled after its password is reset. Restore it separately before the user can sign in.
users.resetFailed: The password could not be reset. Check the details and try again.
users.resetRetryNotice: For a retry, re-enter and confirm the same temporary password, then enter your current administrator password. Keep the reason and username unchanged.
users.resetReadOnly: Only a super administrator can reset another account's password. Your access is read-only.
users.resetSelf: You cannot reset your own password here. Use your account's password settings.
users.resetUnknown: Password reset is unavailable because this account's status is unknown. Refresh the account and try again.
users.resetUnavailable: Password reset is not available for this account. Deployment account restrictions still apply; contact your deployment operator.
users.initialUsernameHint: Use 3–32 letters, numbers or underscores. This becomes the account's sign-in username.
users.invalidUsername: Enter a username with 3–32 letters, numbers or underscores.
users.usernameTaken: This username is already in use. Choose another username.
users.invalidTempPassword: Enter a temporary password with 6–128 characters.

installations.title: Managed installations
installations.description: Verified installation identities, with independent client activity, daemon reachability and execution readiness.
installations.legacy_description: These runtimes have no verified installation binding. Names, IP addresses and usage identifiers are not used to merge them.
installations.name: Installation
installations.truncated: Some detail rows were omitted. Narrow the list or inspect related workspaces.
installations.dependency_unavailable: Liveness is temporarily unavailable. The table does not classify this as a terminal outage.
installations.readiness_notice: Ready means the basic prerequisites are present. Each task still checks permissions, capacity and queue conditions.
installations.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select and copy the full installation ID below.

operations.stopNotice: Stop new claims on this installation. Work already claimed continues and may start after this change.
operations.resumeNotice: Allow this installation to claim new executions again.
operations.cancelNotice: Cancel only this execution. Other attempts and the original issue are unchanged. Server acceptance does not confirm that the remote process has stopped.
operations.conflict: The target changed or this request conflicts with an earlier operation. Refresh the target before starting another request.
operations.failed: The request was rejected. Review the target and your access before trying again.
operations.uncertain: The outcome is uncertain. Keep this original request and key; check its status or retry the same request.
operations.notRecorded: No receipt is visible yet. The original request may still commit. Check again or retry using this same key.
operations.manual: Status checks run briefly while this page is open. You can refresh at any time; leaving this page does not cancel the operation.
operations.readFailed: Status is unavailable. The last receipt below is retained; refresh to check again.

results.cancelled_before_dispatch: Cancelled before dispatch. No daemon acknowledgement was needed.
results.awaiting_daemon_confirmation: The server cancelled this execution. Waiting for the daemon to confirm that it stopped.
results.confirmation_unavailable: The server cancelled this execution. This runtime cannot provide a managed process confirmation.
results.already_terminal: The execution was already finished. No cancellation was applied to it.
results.already_cancelled_unverified: The execution was already cancelled. Its process state has not been verified.
results.daemon_stopped: The daemon reported that this execution stopped.
results.admission_stopped: The server has stopped new claims. In-flight work continues.
results.admission_accepting: The server permits new claims again.
results.unknown: No recognized completion evidence is available.
results.execution_fence_conflict: The execution changed before cancellation. This request did not cancel it. Refresh the target before starting a new request.

operations.storageFailed: The original request could not be preserved. No new operation was sent. Restore browser storage access and refresh.
operations.reasonRequired: Enter a reason. Spaces alone are not enough.
operations.initialReadFailed: Cannot load this receipt. Refresh to try again.

observability.title: Overview
observability.description: Follow current capacity, finished executions, and outstanding alerts across the organization.
observability.errorHint: Refresh to check the source again. Missing data does not mean there are no problems.
observability.windowHint: Times above use UTC. The display time zone applies to results. End time is exclusive; reporting ranges are limited to {{days}} days.
observability.liveHint: Queue and installation counts reflect the latest snapshot, independently of the selected completion window.
observability.finishedHint: Success rate is completed ÷ (completed + failed). Cancelled and unfinished executions are shown separately.
observability.tokensHint: Token counts include reported usage from failed executions. They are not a bill or an estimated charge.
observability.alertHistoryTitle: Alert history first observed in this window
observability.alertHistoryHint: Recovered and closed alerts are counted by their first observation time in the selected window. Active alerts above include all ages.
observability.attentionHint: Open alerts and waiting work reflect the current snapshot, regardless of the historical window.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: Investigate fixed-rule alerts, record ownership, and track recovery separately from acknowledgement.
alerts.activeNotice: By default, all active alerts are shown, including those first seen before the reporting window.
alerts.subject: Subject
alerts.ownerHint: Only active administrators with completed password setup are eligible.
alerts.moreOwners: More administrators match. Refine the search.
alerts.acknowledgeNotice: Acknowledgement records that someone is investigating. It does not mean the condition recovered.
alerts.assignNotice: Assignment changes responsibility for this alert. It does not change the underlying execution.
alerts.closeNotice: Close with a reason and a disposition. A failed execution remains a historical failure.

rules.queue_timeout: Execution queued for over five minutes

resolutions.queue_below_threshold: The queue wait is below the threshold
resolutions.task_removed: The queued task no longer exists

alerts.closeRecoveredNotice: Close this recovered alert with a reason. The recorded recovery evidence remains available.

results.alert_acknowledged: The alert was acknowledged. Recovery remains a separate observation.
results.alert_assigned: The alert's responsible administrator was updated.
results.alert_closed: The alert was closed with its recorded conclusion.
results.alert_version_conflict: The alert changed before this request. Refresh it before starting a new operation.
results.alert_state_conflict: The alert's current state does not allow this operation.
results.alert_assignee_unavailable: The selected administrator is no longer eligible. Choose an active administrator.
results.alert_resolution_invalid: The disposition or linked retry could not be verified.

alerts.failureRecordHint: Closing this alert records its handling; it does not change the failed execution.

health.title: Service health
health.description: Source observations and detector freshness. Unavailable telemetry is not evidence that every installation is offline.

settings.title: Deployment settings
settings.description: Read-only settings supplied by the deployment. Changes are made through deployment configuration.
settings.retentionHint: Unconfigured values are unknown. Engineering targets are not enforced retention policies.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.description: Organization membership and execution metadata. Private workspace configuration remains restricted.
workspaces.name: Workspace

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.description: Append-only administrative activity and controlled state changes.
audit.snapshotUnknown: Historical actor name was not captured
audit.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select and copy the actor ID below.

filters.rangeHint: Enter times in UTC. The end is exclusive; reporting ranges are limited to {{days}} days.

errors.invalidTime: Enter a valid date and time.
errors.invalidId: Enter a complete UUID, for example a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001.
errors.invalidTimezone: Enter a valid IANA time zone, such as UTC or Asia/Shanghai.
errors.invalidRange: The end must be later than the start.
errors.rangeTooLong: Choose a reporting range of {{days}} days or less.
errors.futureTime: Choose a time that is not in the future.
errors.tooLong: This value is too long or contains invalid characters. Shorten it and remove null characters.

resources.title: Resource publishing
resources.description: Publish skills and MCP templates to this deployment’s markets. People choose when to add and configure them.
resources.unavailable: Resource publishing is temporarily unavailable. Refresh to try again.
resources.unsupported: This server does not support resource publishing. Update the server to use this page.
resources.disabled: Publishing is not enabled for this deployment. Ask the deployment operator to configure managed resource storage.
resources.readonly: You have read-only access. A platform administrator can publish and withdraw managed resources.
resources.name: Resource
resources.immutable: Managed by the deployment; read-only here.
resources.keyHint: Use letters, numbers, hyphens or underscores. The key identifies this resource in the market.
resources.skillHint: Choose SKILL.md, .zip or .skill. Packages must contain SKILL.md and UTF-8 text attachments.
resources.reasonHint: Describe why this resource is being published, updated or withdrawn.
resources.fileRequired: Choose a resource key and file to continue.
resources.publishImpact: This resource will appear in deployment markets. Existing workspace copies, configuration and bindings remain unchanged.
resources.withdrawImpact: This resource will no longer be offered in deployment markets. Existing workspace copies, configuration and bindings remain unchanged.
resources.publishedSuccess: Resource published. Supported clients discover it on their next catalog refresh, usually within 30 seconds.
resources.withdrawnSuccess: Resource withdrawn. Existing workspace copies and bindings are unchanged.
resources.unknownOutcome: The result is not yet confirmed. Check the operation receipt before starting another change; do not upload again.
resources.pendingReceipt: No confirmed receipt is available yet. Wait a moment, then check again.
resources.invalid: The file or resource key failed validation. Check the supported format and limits, then preview again.
resources.conflict: The resource changed or its key is already reserved. Refresh the catalog and validate your file again.
resources.previewChanged: The upload no longer matches the preview. Validate the selected file again.
resources.storeFull: Managed resource storage has reached its limit. Contact the deployment operator.
resources.forbidden: Your permission has changed. Refresh your administration access.
resources.failed: The request failed. Your selected file has been kept; try again when the service is available.
resources.tooLarge: The selected file exceeds the upload limit.
resources.draftCancelled: Draft cancelled. Choose a file to start again.
resources.withdrawChanged: This resource changed after you opened this confirmation. Cancel and select Withdraw again to review the latest revision.
